0.0: Hiya #b#e#h0##k#n! The name's #b#e#p9000185##k#n, and I'm here to tell you about the new #r#eMaple Chat#k#n system!\r\n
0.1: If you love chatting as much as I do, you're going to loooove\r\n#r#eMaple Chat#k#n. You can keep an open line to your friends while you adventure AND you can compete with the rest of the world to see who's the #b#emost likable player#k#n every week.\r\n
0.2: Can I give you all the #r#edetails#k#n? Please? I want to get in good with my new boss! She's so stern and obsessed with paperwork.

yes.3: #i3800486# Do you know what #b#ethis#k#n is? This is where you can check out your #r#eLikability#k#n!
yes.4: You can #b#eexchange Likability points during any random chat#k#n. You can only give #r#eone point to each person per day#k#n, up to #r#e10 times total#k#n. #i3800487#
yes.5: Your Likability points reset #r#eevery Monday at midnight#k#n. The guy and the gal with the #b#emost Likability points#k#n will be displayed in the Hall of Honor here! Isn't that cool?#i3800488#.
yes.6: Pretty crazy right? If you want to be on that board, you have to #r#etreat others with respect#k#n and be #r#eentertaining#k#n. Make it snappy, that's what Eileen says!
yes.7: There are #b#ethree ways#k#n to get into your chat: #i3800489##r#ePrivate Chat, Group Chat, and Friend Chat#k#n!
yes.8: Private and Group chats are #r#erandomnized#k#n. You never know who you'll end up talking to!
yes.9: #i03800490# Choose #r#ePrivate Chat#k#n for\r\n#b#epersonal conversations#k#n and #r#eGroup Chat#k#n for #b#eexciting community chats#k#n. Simple, right?
